import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int T = 99;
    static final int C = 12;
    static final long INF = 0x3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long INFLL = 0x3f3f3f3f3f3f3f3fL;
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static final double EPS = 1e-10;

    static class Edge {
        int v, r;
        long f, c, p;
        Edge(int v, int r, long f, long c, long p) {
            this.v = v; this.r = r; this.f = f; this.c = c; this.p = p;
        }
    }

    static class Flow {
        static final int N = 50 * T + 2;
        static ArrayList<Edge>[] adj = new ArrayList[N];
        static int[] sz = new int[N];
        static long mc;

        static void init(int n) {
            mc = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                sz[i] = 0;
                adj[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
        }

        static void add_edge(int a, int b, long c, long p) {
            mc = Math.max(mc, c);
            adj[a].add(new Edge(b, sz[b]++, 0, c, p));
            adj[b].add(new Edge(a, sz[a]++, 0, 0, -p));
        }
    }

    static boolean[] vis = new boolean[Flow.N];
    static int[] par = new int[Flow.N];
    static long[] pot = new long[Flow.N];
    static long[] dist = new long[Flow.N];

    static void pot_init(int n) {
        Arrays.fill(pot, 0);
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int u = 0; u < n; u++) {
                for (Edge e : Flow.adj[u]) {
                    if (e.c != 0) {
                        long newPot = pot[u] + e.p;
                        if (newPot < pot[e.v]) {
                            pot[e.v] = newPot;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long mcf(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
        Arrays.fill(vis, false);
        Arrays.fill(dist, INF);
        dist[s] = 0;
        PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
        if (sparse) {
            pq.offer(new long[]{0, s});
            while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
                long[] u = pq.poll();
                int uNode = (int) u[1];
                if (vis[uNode]) continue;
                vis[uNode] = true;
                for (Edge e : Flow.adj[uNode]) {
                    if (e.f < e.c) {
                        long nd = dist[uNode] + pot[uNode] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                        if (dist[e.v] > nd) {
                            dist[e.v] = nd;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                            pq.offer(new long[]{-nd, e.v});
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            int u = s;
            while (u != -1) {
                vis[u] = true;
                for (Edge e : Flow.adj[u]) {
                    if (e.f < e.c) {
                        long nd = dist[u] + pot[u] - pot[e.v] + e.p;
                        if (dist[e.v] > nd) {
                            dist[e.v] = nd;
                            par[e.v] = e.r;
                        }
                    }
                }
                long best = INF;
                int nextU = -1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                    if (!vis[i] && dist[i] < best) {
                        best = dist[i];
                        nextU = i;
                    }
                }
                u = nextU;
            }
        }
        if (dist[t] >= INF) return 0;
        long df = INF;
        for (int u = t; u != s; u = Flow.adj[Flow.adj[par[u]].get(0).v].get(0).v) {
            Edge r = Flow.adj[Flow.adj[u].get(par[u]).v].get(par[u]);
            long residualCap = Flow.adj[r.v].get(r.r).c - Flow.adj[r.v].get(r.r).f;
            if (residualCap < df) df = residualCap;
        }
        for (int u = t; u != s; u = Flow.adj[Flow.adj[par[u]].get(0).v].get(0).v) {
            Edge r = Flow.adj[Flow.adj[u].get(par[u]).v].get(par[u]);
            Edge e = Flow.adj[r.v].get(r.r);
            e.f += df;
            Flow.adj[r.v].get(r.r).f -= df;
            price[0] += df * e.p;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (dist[i] + pot[i] < INF) {
                pot[i] = Math.min(INF, dist[i] + pot[i]);
            }
        }
        return df;
    }

    static long min_cost_flow(int s, int t, long[] price, int n, boolean sparse) {
        long flow = 0;
        price[0] = 0;
        while (true) {
            long df = mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse);
            if (df == 0) break;
            flow += df;
        }
        return flow;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int m = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int d = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int source = 0;
        int sink = n * T + 1;

        Flow.init(sink + 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int a = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
            Flow.add_edge(source, a, 1, 0);
        }

        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            Flow.add_edge(1 + t * n, sink, INF, 0);
            if (t > 0) {
                for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(i + (t - 1) * n, i + t * n, INF, c);
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int a = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            int b = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
            for (int j = 0; j < C; j++) {
                int cost = (j + 1) * (j + 1) - j * j;
                for (int t = 1; t < T; t++) {
                    Flow.add_edge(a + (t - 1) * n, b + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                    Flow.add_edge(b + (t - 1) * n, a + t * n, 1, cost * d + c);
                }
            }
        }

        long[] price = new long[1];
        long flow = min_cost_flow(source, sink, price, sink + 1, true);
        assert flow == k;
        System.out.println(price[0]);
    }
}
